answers.rationale: The requirement pertains to the physical dimensions and shipment details of switchgear cubicles. The CROWN-ARMV product is the default for metal-clad switchgear lines, which includes such cubicles.
The CT relaying accuracy class is a technical specification related to switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product includes CTs as part of its standard offering.
Bus material and cross-section dimensions are part of the switchgear's technical specifications. The CROWN-ARMV product includes bus and construction details.
The RMS symmetrical rating (bus bracing) is a technical specification of switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is designed to meet such requirements.
The maximum temperature rise in a 40°C ambient is a technical specification of switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product is engineered to meet such environmental conditions.
The manufacturer, model/type, and various ratings are specific to the switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product includes these details as part of its offering.
